notes.title: Meet Ellie!
notes.notes: [p]Exciting news! [i]Lucky Break: Dating in New York[/i] is back in full swing. Our talented writer, Teodora Mišeljić is working on bringing your future dates to life with the magic of her writing.[/p][p]And what better way to celebrate than by introducing one of your upcoming romantic interests?[/p][p][b]Meet Ellie Park, [/b]a sweet 23-year-old barista with a love for cozy coffee shops and quiet corners of the city. ![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649810/81d4e319f51cf057df088537b85f238f74dc0162.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Name:[/b] Ellie Park[/p][p][b]Age:[/b] 23[/p][p][b]From:[/b] Soul, South Kore[b]a[/b][/p][p][b]Lives:[/b] in Brooklyn, New York[/p][p][b]Height:[/b] 5’6” (167 cm)[/p][p][b]Likes:[/b] Good books, art, café hopping, long walks[/p][p][b]Dislikes:[/b] Alarm clocks[/p][p][b]Looking for:[/b] Someone to hide away from the world with[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649810/ad90069f1683b57692c5408d451d84ce53be0e97.png"][/img][/p][p]So here’s the big question: Would you take Ellie out? And if so… where’s your perfect NYC date spot?[/p][p][/p]
